simple.meaning: אֲגֻדָּה (ʼăguddâh) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a band , bundle , knot , or arch.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 12:22. The surrounding context includes blood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֲגֻדָּה (H92) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: אֲגֻדָּה (ʼăguddâh) / H92 is traced through Exodus 12:22, 2 Samuel 2:25, Isaiah 58:6, Amos 9:6 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.short: a band , bundle , knot , or arch
definitions.full: H92. aguddah אֲגֻדָּה noun feminine band (Mishna אֲגוּדָּה compare NHWB). 1 plural construct מוֺטָה אֲגֻדּוֺת bands, thongs (fastening ox-bow) metaphor of fetters of slavery Isa 58:6 . 2 אֵזוֺב אֲגֻדַּת bunch of hyssop Exod 12:22 . 3 ׳א absolute band of men (compare חֶבֶל . English band ) 2Sam 2:25 . 4 אֲגֻדָּתוֺ vault of the heavens (as fitted together, constructed, compare Arabic ) Amos 9:6 .
definitions.rootNote: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to bind );

occurrences.englishText: You shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two door posts with the blood that is in the basin. None of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.
The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.
“Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen:
It is he who builds his rooms in the heavens, and has founded his vault on the earth; he who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth; Yahweh is his name.
